findings.title: Light-theme value changed from 30% to 70%, altering existing appearance
findings.body: The original rule was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`. The new light-branch is `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%)`, paired with `$secondary` at 30%. The PR is meant to add dark-theme handling without changing the light theme, but this makes the author link in embedded post headers much lighter on light themes, reducing contrast. The light branch should stay at 30% and the dark branch should be `$secondary` at 70%.

findings.title: Group member name colour changed from 30% to 50% in the light theme
findings.body: The original rule used `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`. The new code uses 50% for the light branch and the dark branch. This lightens the name for light themes, a regression the PR was not meant to cause. It should be `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`.

findings.title: Group member name light-theme lightness silently changed from 30% to 50%
findings.body: The original `.group-member-info .name` colour was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`. It is now 50% for both light and dark branches, so the light theme gets a lighter, lower-contrast name. The light branch should stay at 30%, with `$secondary` at 70% for dark.

findings.title: Topic map h3 colour changed from 20% to 50% in the light theme
findings.body: The original was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%)`. The new code uses 50% for both branches. The light theme heading becomes noticeably lighter, which is unintended. The 20%/80% pair used elsewhere in the same file would preserve the light theme.

findings.title: Light-theme lightness changed from 70% to 30%, making the text much darker
findings.body: The original was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%)`. The new light branch is `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`, with `$secondary` at 70%. The light and dark arguments are swapped relative to the other changes. Light themes get much darker text for `.custom-message-length`. It should be `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%))`, which matches desktop/modal.scss.
